business_problem: healthcare providers were missing booked appointments because patients faced fear, confusion, and transport barriers, while Spryt also needed to replace a fragmented AI stack with a secure platform that could satisfy major healthcare buyers.
solution_summary: Spryt uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: healthcare providers were missing booked appointments because patients faced fear, confusion, and transport barriers, while Spryt also needed to replace a fragmented AI stack with a secure platform that could satisfy major healthcare buyers. Gemini powers Cortex and Sentinel to reason over patient conversations, check responses for safety and compliance, and decide when a human should take over, serving as the compute layer. TensorFlow runs prediction models that identify patients at risk of missing or canceling appointments before outreach begins, serving as the compute layer. Google Kubernetes Engine runs the multi-agent Asa platform and scales patient engagement services for production healthcare deployments, serving as the orchestration layer. Cloud SQL supports Spryt’s MySQL database for the scheduling and engagement application, serving as the storage layer.
